newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo tobacco firm to get 282 mln DM credit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Yugo tobacco firm to get 282 mln DM credit - paper.

text.p: Yugoslav tobacco factory Duvanska industrija Nis (DIN) is soon to sign a deal with UK merchant bank Singer & Friedlander for a 282 million German mark credit, the newspaper Borba reported on Monday.
The funds will be used to finance the building of a new cigarette factory, printshop and plant for processing large-leaf tobacco, DIN general manager Smiljko Kostic was quoted by the paper as saying.
The deal is expected to be signed in mid-February in the Nis factory, the paper said.
During the last meeting between representatives of DIN and the British bank late last year, it was agreed that the credit will be repaid in 9-1/2 years with a two year grace period, Kostic said.
"Most of the funds will be invested in importing modern machines, which will act as a guarantee for the extended credit, along with the factory's tobacco reserves," Kostic said.
